list_workspaces: list all Prolific workspaces by calling Workspaces.list() and returning a list of Workspace objects
retrieve_workspace: retrieve a single Prolific workspace by ID using Workspaces.retrieve(id) and return a Workspace object
create_workspace: create a new Prolific workspace with a title using Workspaces.create(title='My Workspace')
update_workspace: update an existing Prolific workspace by ID using Workspaces.update(id, title='New Title')
get_workspace_balance: get the balance for a Prolific workspace by ID using Workspaces.get_balance(id) and return a WorkspaceBalance object
